## Problem 1 - Tidyverse: New Zealand

### (a) Total Votes by Election Year and Voting Type

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

nzge <- readRDS("data/nzge.rds")
```

```{r}
vote_counts <- nzge %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_votes))

print(vote_counts, n = Inf)

```

\

### (b) Candidate Vote Proportions by Party in 2014

```{r}
candidate_votes_2014 <- nzge %>%
  filter(election_year == 2014, voting_type == "Candidate") %>%
  group_by(party) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent_vote = 100 * total_votes / sum(total_votes)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_vote)) %>%
  mutate(percent_vote = round(percent_vote, 2))

print(candidate_votes_2014, n = Inf)

```

\

### (c) Winning Parties by Election Year and Voting Type

```{r}
winning_parties <- nzge %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type, party) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(election_year, voting_type, party) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = voting_type, values_from = party) %>%
  arrange(election_year)

print(winning_parties, n = Inf)

```

## Problem 2 - Tidyverse: Tennis

### (a) Number of Tournaments in 2019

```{r}
atp2019 <- read_csv("data/atp_matches_2019.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

```{r}
tournament_count <- atp2019 %>%
  summarise(n_tournaments = n_distinct(tourney_id))

print(tournament_count)

```
There were **128 tournaments** in the 2019 ATP Matches dataset, determined by counting the distinct tournament IDs.

\

### (b) Players Winning Multiple Tournaments

```{r}
multiple_title_winners <- atp2019 %>%
  filter(round == "F") %>%
  group_by(winner_id, winner_name) %>%
  summarise(tournaments_won = n_distinct(tourney_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(tournaments_won > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(tournaments_won), winner_name)

print(multiple_title_winners, n = Inf)

multiple_title_winners %>%
  summarise(
    n_players = n(),
    max_tournaments = max(tournaments_won)
  ) %>%
  print()

```
Yes. In 2019, **12 players** won more than one tournament. **Dominic Thiem and Novak Djokovic** tied for the most tournament titles, each winning **5 tournaments**.

\

### (c) Comparing Aces Between Winners and Losers

```{r}
ace_comparison <- atp2019 %>%
  filter(!is.na(w_ace), !is.na(l_ace)) %>%
  mutate(ace_diff = w_ace - l_ace) %>%
  summarise(
    n_matches = n(),
    mean_winner = mean(w_ace),
    mean_loser = mean(l_ace),
    mean_diff = mean(ace_diff),
    se_diff = sd(ace_diff) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower_ci = mean_diff - 1.96 * se_diff,
    upper_ci = mean_diff + 1.96 * se_diff
  ) %>%
  select(-se_diff)

print(ace_comparison, width = Inf)

```
Yes. Based on 2,694 matches with complete ace records, winners averaged **7.50 aces** per match, compared with **5.79 aces** for losers. The mean paired difference was approximately **1.70 aces** (the reported means and mean difference were calculated using unrounded values and rounded separately for display), with an approximate 95% confidence interval of **[1.43, 1.97]**.

Since the entire confidence interval is above zero, there is statistical evidence that winners tend to have more aces than losers.

\

### (d) Players with the Highest Win Rate

```{r}
player_results <- bind_rows(
  atp2019 %>%
    transmute(player_id = winner_id, player_name = winner_name, won = 1),
  atp2019 %>%
    transmute(player_id = loser_id, player_name = loser_name, won = 0)
)

top_win_rate <- player_results %>%
  group_by(player_id, player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    matches_played = n(),
    matches_won = sum(won),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(matches_played >= 5) %>%
  mutate(win_rate = matches_won / matches_played) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = win_rate, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(player_name)

print(top_win_rate, n = Inf)

```
**Rafael Nadal** had the highest win rate among players who participated in at least 5 matches. He won **60 out of 69 matches**, achieving a win rate of approximately **87.0%**.
